#!/bin/bash

# Read from stdin to get pushed refs
while read oldrev newrev refname; do
    branch=$(basename $refname)

    case $branch in
        main)
            # Deploy main branch to /var/www/main
            WORK_DIR="/tmp/deploy-main-$$"
            mkdir -p "$WORK_DIR"
            git --work-tree="$WORK_DIR" checkout -f main

            # Copy index.html if it exists
            if [ -f "$WORK_DIR/index.html" ]; then
                cp "$WORK_DIR/index.html" /var/www/main/
                chmod 644 /var/www/main/index.html
            fi

            # Cleanup
            rm -rf "$WORK_DIR"
            echo "Deployed main branch"
            ;;
        dev)
            # Deploy dev branch to /var/www/dev
            WORK_DIR="/tmp/deploy-dev-$$"
            mkdir -p "$WORK_DIR"
            git --work-tree="$WORK_DIR" checkout -f dev

            # Copy index.html if it exists
            if [ -f "$WORK_DIR/index.html" ]; then
                cp "$WORK_DIR/index.html" /var/www/dev/
                chmod 644 /var/www/dev/index.html
            fi

            # Cleanup
            rm -rf "$WORK_DIR"
            echo "Deployed dev branch"
            ;;
        *)
            echo "Branch $branch ignored (no deployment configured)"
            ;;
    esac
done
